source_context: The .009 assembly places C88 in the D9/D7 gap, and sheet-1 supply detail draws C88 across +5 V and ground.
decision: Use front (3030,1365) GND-side and (2978,1530) +5 V-side drilled annuli as the leading C88 footprint search pair. Opposite-face hole matches and rail paths are strong photo evidence but require owner continuity before a physical footprint is assigned. Retire the shorter (3030,1365)/(3060,1420) pair because its lower conductor reaches D5.25/IORD. Value and owner/factory population history remain open.

rail_consistent_c88_pair: Upper front drill (3030,1365), proved complete in alternate component view 200415237, projects through corrected D9 fit to solder (2521.5,1076.6), matching broad-strip hole (2520,1082) within ≈6 px. A separate D7-local x fit agrees within 0.07 mm. The lower candidate is only about 1.6 mm from the inherited source C35.1 site (117.1,120.9), so reconcile physical sites and clearances before placement. Owner same-hole and rail continuity are still unmeasured; do not promote the footprint solely from pixels.
